ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, if the number of ferns decreases, what will most likely happen to the supply of salmon?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram contains labeled green ovals connected by blue arrows. Near the lower left is an oval labeled “Ferns.” Above and slightly to the right of it is an oval labeled “Salmon.” A blue arrow runs upward from “Ferns” to “Salmon,” showing a connection from ferns to salmon in this diagram. Reasoning: The question asks what will most likely happen to the supply of salmon if the number of ferns decreases. Since the diagram shows salmon depending on ferns through the arrow connection, a decrease in ferns would reduce the support or food source for salmon. Therefore, the supply of salmon would most likely decrease.
